title: The Greater Bengaluru Governance Bill, 2024
summary: 'The Greater Bengaluru Governance Bill, 2024' (Bill No. 34 of 2024) is a State legislative measure introduced in the Karnataka Legislative Assembly (Vidhan Sabha) concerning Municipal Administration & Urban Development. The bill introduces statutory amendments to existing state legislation, primarily modifying City Corporation under this Act across 1 identified sections/clauses.
